summary: The KTH Scholarship covers full tuition for both years of a master's at KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm (second year if first-year results are satisfactory). It does not pay living costs. It goes to top fee-paying applicants: in 2026 about 9% of admitted applicants (65 of 718) received it.
lookfor: Ranking of the university where you did your bachelor's
Extra merits: research, publications, work or teaching experience, awards, activities
Your motivation: how you will contribute to sustainable development with a KTH master's
cycle: Programme application on universityadmissions.se opens 16 October 2026 and closes 15 January 2027; the KTH scholarship form opens 1 December 2026 and closes 15 January 2027; supporting documents due by 1–2 February 2027; admission and scholarship results 1 April 2027.

eligibility.q: Will you be a fee-paying student (not EU/EEA/Swiss)?
eligibility.no: EU/EEA/Swiss students do not pay tuition, so this award is not for you.

eligibility.q: Will you rank a KTH master's programme as your first priority on universityadmissions.se?
eligibility.no: The scholarship only considers your first-choice programme if it is at KTH.

eligibility.q: Is your first-choice programme an eligible KTH programme (two-year master's or listed exceptions, not joint Erasmus+/EIT programmes)?
eligibility.no: Check the KTH scholarship page's list and pick an eligible programme.

eligibility.q: Will you pay the SEK 900 application fee?
eligibility.no: The fee is required for non-EU applicants before your application is processed.

eligibility.q: Is your academic record near the top of your class (e.g. First Class or strong Second Class Upper)?
eligibility.no: You can still apply, but also apply for the Swedish Institute or Erasmus Mundus scholarships.

steps.title: Pick your first-choice KTH programme
steps.why: Only your first-priority KTH programme is considered for the scholarship.
do: Open the KTH master's programme list and shortlist programmes in your field.
On each programme page, check entry requirements and programme-specific documents.
Confirm the programme is eligible on the KTH Scholarship page (two-year master's; not joint Erasmus+/EIT).
Decide which KTH programme goes first; you can rank up to four programmes in total.
tips: Look at programme acceptance rates; KTH's average admission rate in 2026 was 31%.
check: My first choice is an eligible KTH programme.

steps.title: Understand how KTH scores you
steps.why: Knowing the criteria tells you what to highlight in your documents.
do: Read the selection criteria on the KTH Scholarship page.
List your grades, class position, research, work, teaching, awards and activities.
Note one or two concrete ways you will contribute to sustainable development.
tips: KTH uses the documents you send to universityadmissions.se for the scholarship — make them strong.
avoid: Treating the scholarship form as a formality.
check: I know the four things KTH scores.

steps.title: Build your timeline
steps.why: You must meet both the programme and scholarship deadlines.
do: Mark 16 October 2026 (application opens), 1 December 2026 (scholarship form opens), 15 January 2027 (both close), 1 February 2027 (documents).
Plan transcript request for late October.
Plan English test, if needed, before December.
tips: Aim to finish both by 5 January to allow for problems.
check: All four dates are in my calendar.

steps.title: Apply on universityadmissions.se and pay the fee
steps.why: The scholarship requires a complete programme application with the fee paid.
do: Create an account on universityadmissions.se once the round opens.
Add your KTH programme as priority 1 and up to three others.
Pay the SEK 900 application fee by card.
Note your application number.
tips: Use your name exactly as it appears in your passport.
check: My application shows KTH first and the fee paid.

steps.title: Send transcripts the correct way
steps.why: For many countries, including Nigeria, transcripts must come directly from your university.
do: Open the country instructions for your country on universityadmissions.se.
Nigeria: once your application is active, ask your university to email your official transcript from its official domain to verifications@uhr.se.
Upload your degree certificate (or latest transcript if still studying) and passport data page.
Make sure names and dates of birth match on every document.
tips: Final-year students can apply if they will have 150 credits by 1 February.
avoid: Sending student copies or requesting transcripts before the application is active.
check: My transcript is sent and my documents are uploaded.

steps.title: Prove your English
steps.why: KTH requires English 6 level (e.g. IELTS 6.5 overall).
do: Check if your degree counts: a fully documented four-year Nigerian bachelor's is considered sufficient by University Admissions.
Otherwise book IELTS Academic or TOEFL and upload results.
Check country-specific rules on universityadmissions.se.
tips: Confirm the exemption on the country page before skipping a test.
avoid: Assuming WAEC English is enough without checking.

steps.title: Write your programme letter of motivation
steps.why: Programmes rate motivation in admission, and KTH uses those documents for the scholarship.
do: Read your programme's requirements for the letter of motivation, CV and summary sheet.
Explain your academic background with results.
Name courses or research groups at KTH that fit your goals.
Show how you will contribute to sustainable development.
Keep to any length set by the programme.
tips: Mention specific projects, publications or awards — these are scholarship criteria.
avoid: A generic letter that could be sent to any university.
check: My letter is specific to the KTH programme.
steps.prompt: Set by each programme — usually your background, why this programme, and your goals.
steps.limit: Set by each programme — check the current guidance.

steps.title: Complete the KTH scholarship form
steps.why: Without this form you are not considered, even if admitted.
do: From 1 December 2026, open the form on the KTH Scholarship page.
Enter your universityadmissions.se details.
Answer how you intend to contribute to sustainable development with a KTH master's.
Submit; no extra documents are needed.
tips: Link your answer to one real problem and one concrete action after graduation.
check: I submitted the form and saved the confirmation.
steps.prompt: How you intend to contribute to sustainable development with a master's degree from KTH.

steps.title: Get references if your programme asks
steps.why: Some KTH programmes request recommendation letters as programme-specific documents.
do: Check your programme's document list for references.
If needed, ask a lecturer who supervised your project.
Send them your CV and programme link and agree a date before 15 January.
tips: Ask referees to mention class rank and research.
check: I have every reference my programme asks for.

steps.title: Final check before the deadline
steps.why: Missing documents mean no admission and no scholarship.
do: Log in to universityadmissions.se and check every document is listed.
Confirm the scholarship form was submitted.
Upload any late documents by 1 February 2027.
check: My application and scholarship form are complete.

links.t: Watch: Webinar | Application Walkthrough (KTH Royal Institute of Technology)

steps.title: Get results and plan next steps
steps.why: Results arrive on 1 April 2027; living costs and residence permit take planning.
do: Check results on 1 April 2027.
If awarded, accept your place and follow KTH's instructions.
Plan funding for living costs — the scholarship covers tuition only.
Apply for a Swedish residence permit for studies.
tips: Also apply for the Swedish Institute scholarship for living costs if you are eligible.
avoid: Applying for the residence permit without proof of living funds.
check: I have a plan for living costs.

faq.q: Does the KTH Scholarship pay living costs?
Do I upload extra documents for the scholarship?
faq.a: No. KTH uses what you sent to universityadmissions.se.

faq.q: Can I apply if KTH is my second choice?
faq.a: No. KTH must be your first priority.
